mentions.h: WELCOME TO THE FOLLOWING NEW MEMBERS
DECEMBER 11th 1977 - BIRMINGHAM - NATIONAL WOMENS 5km CHAMP. OUR GIRLS JUST MISS NATIONAL MEDALS
mentions.note: policewoman; disqualified by the judges on the first lap
6th National Junior 5000m walk at Milksham in her first championship race

photos.c: [illegible]hilst our mens' team was not at its best at Luton on October 30th, our girls made up for it. Highly placed in the 5km walk were (left to right) Anna Matthews 3rd/31:00, Wendy Dunsford 6th/35:22 and Diane Cook 5th/33:39; with Jane Pritchard (right) first home in the under 15 2.5km group and Barbara Dunsford (not in picture) 5th.
Left: Anna Matthews (8) and Diane Cook (1) competed in the Senior Ladies 3,000 metre walk at the Club Championships.
